title: Solasodine suppress MCF7 breast cancer stem-like cells via targeting Hedgehog/Gli1.
authors: Chen, Jing; Ma, Da; Zeng, Cuicui; White, Lorenzo V; Zhang, Huanqing; Teng, Yinglai; Lan, Ping
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物solasodine通过靶向Gli1蛋白抑制乳腺癌干细胞，虽涉及分子对接预测小分子与Gli1结合，但核心是药物作用机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Recently, a novel therapy to treat cancer has been to target cancer stem-like cells (CSCs). The aim of this study was to investigate the effect of solasodine, a steroidal alkaloid isolated from Solanum incanum L., on MCF7 CSCs and to understand the compound's underlying mechanism of action. METHOD: A tumorsphere formation assay was used to evaluate the effects of solasodine on the proliferation and self-renewal ability of MCF7 CSCs. The level of expression of proteins associated with cancer stemness markers and Hh signaling mediators was determined. The interaction between solasodine and Gli1 was calculated by molecular docking and further demonstrated by cellular thermal shift assay. RESULTS: Solasodine significantly decreased the proliferation of MCF7 tumorspheres and showed a stronger cytotoxicity on breast cancer cells with higher levels of Gli1 expression. The results showed that the levels of CD44 and ALDH1 expression were suppressed. Furthermore, expression of CD24 was enhanced by solasodine, via a mechanism that involved dampening Gli1 expression and blocking the nuclear translocation of this protein in MCF7 tumorspheres. Computational studies predicted that solasodine showed a high affinity with the Gli1 zinc finger domain that resulted from hydrogen-bonds to the THR243 and ASP216 amino acids residues. In addition, solasodine specifically bound with Gli1 and enhanced Gli1 protein stability in MCF7 cells. CONCLUSION: Here, our findings indicated that solasodine can directly suppresses Hh/Gli1 signaling, and is a novel anticancer candidate that targets CSCs.
abstract_zh: 背景：近年来，一种针对癌症干细胞样细胞（CSCs）的新型癌症治疗方法备受关注。本研究旨在探讨从刺茄（Solanum incanum L.）中分离的甾体生物碱——茄碱（solasodine）对MCF7 CSCs的影响，并阐明其潜在的作用机制。方法：采用肿瘤球形成实验评估茄碱对MCF7 CSCs增殖和自我更新能力的影响。测定了与癌症干性标志物及Hh信号传导介质相关蛋白的表达水平。通过分子对接计算茄碱与Gli1之间的相互作用，并利用细胞热位移实验进一步验证。结果：茄碱显著降低了MCF7肿瘤球的增殖，并对Gli1表达水平较高的乳腺癌细胞表现出更强的细胞毒性。结果显示，CD44和ALDH1的表达水平受到抑制。此外，茄碱通过抑制Gli1表达并阻断该蛋白在MCF7肿瘤球中的核转位，增强了CD24的表达。计算研究预测，茄碱与Gli1锌指结构域具有高亲和力，这源于与THR243和ASP216氨基酸残基形成的氢键。同时，茄碱特异性结合Gli1并增强MCF7细胞中Gli1蛋白的稳定性。结论：本研究发现表明，茄碱可直接抑制Hh/Gli1信号通路，是一种靶向CSCs的新型抗癌候选药物。
